# @trysac/design-token-sync

> Build CSS custom properties and a typed TypeScript module from Design Tokens (DTCG) JSON, resolving aliases, inheriting types and checking outputs stay in sync. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, no runtime dependencies. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage, public API, CLI and limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and design decisions
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and covered behavior
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): defended and not-defended threat model
